kinship.label: Pairwise kinship
kinship.description: Estimate kinship between samples, including pairs within and between reported families.

related.label: Find close relatives
related.description: Find relatives through the second degree. --noscreen 1 evaluates candidate pairs directly and avoids KING’s unreliable default screening on very small cohorts.

bysnp.label: Variant quality control
bysnp.description: Summarize genotypes and missingness for each variant.
